sources.snippet: C2S-Scale-Gemma Hybrid Model A dual-encoder + late-fusion system for single-cell transcriptomics that combines Cell2Sentence / C2S-Scale-Gemma with UHG-based graph learning. This repository is now being extended toward an OKSM / OSKM reprogramming research workflow focused on: modeling productive vs alternative reprogramming trajectories

sources.title: Google's Gemma AI model helps discover new potential cancer therapy pathway
sources.snippet: C2S-Scale 27B, a new foundation model built on Gemma AI and validated in the lab, is transforming single-cell analysis and may help provide a novel pathway for cancer therapy.
